# Local Storage Shim

A super simple fake `localStorage` for when you're running in the CLI or Bare.

## What it does

- Gives you the classic `getItem`, `setItem`, `removeItem`, `clear`, `key(index)` and `length`.
- Just saves it to `.local-storage/storage.json` in the folder the cli runs in, so your stuff is still there when you restart.
- `reset_all()` deletes that folder and the `storage-*` folders and `*-seedphrase` files there, its what "Reset All Data" does on the cli.
- The vault only keeps its session values in it (`username`, `joined_app`, the pending invite). Bare only (it uses `bare-fs`).
- Means we can use the exact same state code in the browser and CLI without rewriting everything.

## Usage

```javascript
// lib/run.js requires it first, it sets global.localStorage if there isnt one
require('local-storage-shim')

// Now you can use localStorage safely anywhere
localStorage.setItem('username', 'alice')
const name = localStorage.getItem('username')
```
